data.narrative:
Sunflower Labs is a Series B-stage drone and autonomous systems company that has raised $41.7M to date. The broader Drones & Autonomous sector comprises eight private peers—including Elroy Air, Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, and Archer Aviation—with no public comparables available for direct benchmarking.

Valuation triangulation relied on a single applicable method: stage-progression analysis. Using total capital raised ($42M) as a baseline proxy, the analysis applied a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B to subsequent-stage step-ups, yielding an implied valuation of $79M. This reflects the operational and capital intensity inherent in hardware-dependent autonomous systems at mid-stage development. A peer-median approach was not viable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow drone & autonomous subsector; applying an all-sector median would introduce excessive noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $67M (low) to $91M (high), with a central estimate of $79M. This range reflects inherent uncertainty around the application of a single method and the absence of direct peer validation. Key risks to valuation include technology development velocity, regulatory pathway clarity, and capital efficiency relative to sector peers. Given the data constraints, investors should weight this estimate as indicative of magnitude rather than precision, pending additional comparables or financial operating metrics.
